title: G-0007 no-symlinks migration lint
body_md: G-0007 forbids symlinks during migrations. Add a CI/local lint: bin/lint-migrations.sh greps src/ledger/migrate.ts and any migration files for `symlink(`, `symlinkSync`, `ln -s`. Fail loud. Wire into bin/merge-gate.sh.
acceptance_md: bin/lint-migrations.sh exits 1 on a fixture that contains symlinkSync; exits 0 on clean tree; merge-gate invokes it.
evidence_md: Merged to main as 589e208 on 2026-05-19; HITL review child merged.
